# Dependency Review Exceptions
# Allowed GitHub Security Advisories (GHSAs) for dependency-review-action.
# Mirrors .trivyignore conventions: each GHSA entry requires an Expiration
# directive. Expired exceptions cause CI to fail, forcing periodic review.
# Expiration dates land on a Wednesday, per the expiry grid documented in
# docs/CONTAINER_SECURITY.md (#1337).
#
# Format:
#   # <GHSA-ID>: <short description>
#   # Risk Assessment: <level>
#   # - <detail>
#   # Mitigation: <description>
#   Expiration: <YYYY-MM-DD>
#   <GHSA-ID>

# (GHSA-wvrr-2x4r-394v — bats-file@0.2.0 npm malware false positive — was
#  removed on 2026-11-17 (#2043): bats-file now comes from nixpkgs via
#  nix/bats.nix, and no npm manifest in the repo references it, so
#  dependency-review can no longer report it. The register holds no entries.)
